title: patch-release labeling workflow (.github/workflows/patch.js): read PR body, author and labels from context.payload.pull_request instead of re-fetching them
answers: Why does the patch-release labeling workflow no longer make extra GitHub API calls to get the PR body or labels?
How do I read the PR author or description inside a GitHub Actions script without an extra API request?
Where is the bot-author skip and branch-X.Y skip for the patch version label handled?
Which GitHub API calls are still made by the patch-release labeling script?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/patch.js:module.exports is the github-script run on pull_request events to decide whether a PR gets a patch-release version label. It skips PRs whose base is branch-X.Y, skips PRs filed by bots (except Copilot), checks for an existing vX.Y.Z label, lists releases, and writes the new label via issues.addLabels.
Rule: Inside a pull_request-triggered actions script, destructure body, user, labels and number from context.payload.pull_request and use them directly; do not call pulls.get or issues.listLabelsOnIssue for data the event payload already carries. Keep API calls for data the payload lacks (release listing) and for writes (issues.addLabels), and pass pull_number as issue_number.
Constraints: Applies only to fields present on the triggering event payload. The payload is a snapshot from when the event fired, so labels added later in the same run will not appear. Bot filter semantics are unchanged: skip when user.type is Bot unless user.login is Copilot.
applies: GitHub Actions scripts (actions/github-script) triggered by pull_request events, exemplified by .github/workflows/patch.js; not for workflows that need fresh state mid-run.
says: The patch release labeling automation is hitting rate limits on new pull requests.
Reduce unnecessary API queries during automated pull request patch version labeling.
Pull request triage automation is slow because it refetches existing description and labels.
Ensure pull requests opened by automated bots do not receive patch release tags.
search: In pull_request-triggered GitHub Actions scripts like .github/workflows/patch.js:module.exports, read body, user, labels, and number directly from context.payload.pull_request rather than calling pulls.get or issues.listLabelsOnIssue. Keep API calls only for data the payload lacks, such as listing releases and issues.addLabels writes passing pull_number as issue_number. The payload is an event snapshot that excludes later-added labels, and bot filtering skips user.type === 'Bot' unless user.login === 'Copilot', skipping base branches matching branch-X.Y.
